win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 10. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

respins.how_it_works:
Land Stack’n’Sync™ scatter symbols to stack any paying symbol on the reels. A stack of 60 symbols fills the whole reel! Fill an entire reel with the same symbol and sync all reels for massive wins!

 The first time in a round that one or more Stack’n’Sync™ symbols land, the reels where they land will be filled with a stack of 15, 30, 45 or 60 symbols of one kind.
Only 1 Stack’n’Sync™ symbol can land on each reel in a round.

For each Stack’n’Sync™ symbol that lands 1 respin is awarded. If additional Stack’n’Sync™ symbols land during the respins, those reels are synced to the already stacked reels which copies the symbols from the stacked reel and makes the reels stop in the same position.

wilds.name: STAMPEDE SPINS
wilds.behavior:
Bonus game with 10 free spins. In the feature, only these symbols appear: non-paying skull symbols, buffalo symbols and Stack scatter symbols.

Every time that a Stack symbol lands on a reel, 5 - 60 buffalo symbols will be added to that reel to replace skull symbols. For each Stack symbol that lands, 1 additional free spin will be awarded. Land several Stack symbols on each reel to fill them with buffalo symbols for huge wins!

 These symbols are non-paying:

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all High or Low paying symbols.

 The bonus symbol only appears in the base game.
The Stack’n’ Sync™ symbol appears in the base game and Free Spins.
The Stack symbol only appears in Stampede Spins.

scatters.name: STAMPEDE REELS
scatters.behavior:
When a full reel of buffalo symbols land together they activate a Stampede Reel with a multiplier up to 100x! The Stampede Reel multiplier applies to any winning payline with buffalo symbols that connects to the Stampede Reel. If more than one Stampede Reels are part of the same winning payline, their multiplier values will be added together before being applied to the win.

The possible multiplier values are: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x

 BONUS GAMES

 Buffalo Stack’n’Sync™ offers two bonus features triggered by landing the bonus scatter symbol in the base game. Landing 3 bonus symbols awards the Free Spins feature. Landing 4 bonus symbols awards the Stampede Spins feature.

modes.name: FREE SPINS
modes.effects: Bonus game with 10 free spins. This feature offers better odds of landing the Stack’n’Sync™ symbol. In this bonus the high-paying animal symbols are more likely to stack than in the base game. This increases the chances of triggering a large stack of buffalo symbols and getting the biggest wins!
